# Muraduzzaman — SEO / AEO / GEO Specialist

> Senior SEO Specialist at JK Lifestyle Ltd, based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, and working with clients worldwide. 5+ years of experience in technical SEO, on-page and off-page SEO, semantic SEO, and organic growth strategy, covering global and local SEO, Google Business Profile, and e-commerce through Google Merchant Center. Focused on AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and AI-powered search: optimizing content for AI answer boxes and citations in generative engines. Also builds the websites and workflow automation that help search results scale.

## What I do

- **SEO** — technical audits, on-page & off-page, keyword strategy, SERP analysis, topical authority, internal linking, Core Web Vitals
- **Global & Local SEO** — international targeting, Google Business Profile optimization, and local citation building
- **E-commerce SEO** — Google Merchant Center, Shopping feeds, product and catalog optimization
- **AEO** — Answer Engine Optimization: structuring content to win AI answer boxes and featured answers
- **GEO** — Generative Engine Optimization: building entity authority to be cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews
- **AI & automation** — n8n workflows, Claude / OpenAI pipelines, automated content and reporting that scale rankings

## Who I work with

- Startups and B2B / SaaS teams that need senior SEO plus the automation to execute it
- Agencies subcontracting specialist SEO / AEO / GEO work
- Founders rebuilding their organic-growth engine end-to-end
